policy: Discover existing owners before material capability work. Prefer reuse/extend; new semantic ownership needs a demonstrated unmet requirement. Exact semantic ownership is unique.

governance_horizon.short_term: Every material capability change discovers existing owners first, records a reuse/extend/replace/new disposition, and keeps the compact registry in the default handoff read set.
governance_horizon.medium_term: Keep one semantic owner per stable capability, grow cards only when stable responsibilities change, and use CI ownership/audit guards to make duplicate parallel implementations increasingly difficult.
governance_horizon.long_term: Promote mature semantic owners to core_locked; overlapping new capabilities require a demonstrated truthful unmet requirement or an explicit supersession path rather than architectural preference.

active.title: Source identity, preservation and deferred materialization
active.purpose: Own source identity and preservation across locator_verified, content_verified and materialized states so readable/verifiable source information is not lost or blocked by transport friction. Preserved readable representations may create document versions without claiming raw-source materialization; later verified raw bytes enrich the same logical document explicitly. Read projections may expose that existing identity and current preservation provenance without turning operational materialization state into historical market knowledge.
extension_seams: Add SourcePlugin/transport adapters behind the existing source/archive ports.
Add source discovery/watchlist behavior without changing logical document identity semantics.
Add later materialization workers that enrich locator/content-verified documents with raw bytes only after identity/content verification.
Add storage-neutral source-identity/preservation read projections that expose existing provenance without inferring claim authority or rewriting representation identity.

active.title: Claim-scoped Grounded Evidence
active.purpose: Own verification that a claim-scoped EvidenceFragment is exactly grounded in preserved source-derived content before epistemic promotion, and own the typed read boundary that returns that same fragment without exposing storage internals. Grounding/readback may use archived raw PDF/HTML/JSON or a truthful readable representation of content the Agent actually read; locator existence alone is never claim Evidence, later raw materialization never rewrites the fragment's original representation identity, and readback must fail closed when the fragment was not yet knowable at the requested cutoff.
extension_seams: Add a generic parser/artifact grounding mode when a new media type cannot be truthfully represented by existing locators.

Use a truthful source-derived readable representation when claim-relevant PDF content was actually read but raw PDF bytes are pending; preserve the upstream PDF identity/media type separately and never call the representation byte-identical PDF.
Add claim_context annotations without silently promoting them into Reality/Judgment.
Add read-only Evidence navigation by fragment identity through typed ports while preserving claim-scoped content, first-known visibility and exact representation identity.

active.title: Canonical Reality normalization and reconciliation
active.purpose: Own typed Fact normalization, comparability, canonical Reality and explicit reconciliation-conflict semantics. This includes source-supported valid-time precision, observation/as-of state with unknown onset, and a typed read boundary for multi-source disagreement whose historical visibility is derived from member assertion known-time rather than later research curation timestamps.
extension_seams: Add predicate-specific normalization/comparability rules through existing typed profiles.
Add generic Reality projection fields only when real cross-industry evidence cannot be represented truthfully.
Expose explicit reconciliation conflicts through typed read models while deriving historical visibility only from member source-known time.

active.title: Judgment, expectation revision and Outcome memory
active.purpose: Own contemporaneous Judgment representation, source-supported target precision, rationale/revision context and later precision-aware Outcome evaluation without rewriting the original historical Judgment.
extension_seams: Add generic Judgment kinds/relations when cross-industry evidence proves a truthful representation gap.
Add derived presentation over Judgment/Outcome without mutating original assertions.

active.title: Typed point-in-time industrial-memory replay
active.purpose: Own storage-neutral reconstruction of what Reality, Judgment and Outcome records were knowable at a historical cutoff, plus calibrated researcher-readable projections over that filtered memory. Researcher entry uses direct source-grounded membership plus deterministic auditable entailment; presentation may add clearly labelled deterministic time/role/usefulness hints when premises support them, but never mutates canonical truth. Related milestones can be surfaced as informative without satisfying a direct target. Ambiguous role, participant importance and causality belong to the explicitly labelled CAP-0006 MODEL/JUDGMENT lane rather than being forbidden or silently promoted to Reality.
extension_seams: Researcher-readable trajectory/table/graph views over an already-filtered typed snapshot.
New read-only CLI/API/UI projections that do not reimplement knowledge visibility.
Compose direct catalog membership with deterministic discoverability from already-grounded Reality/Judgment; keep the entailment provenance visible and do not promote it into membership truth.
Add deterministic, auditable role or subject entailment when premises come from existing semantic owners and the rule cannot manufacture unsupported historical timing or truth.
Add labelled researcher time/range/as-of hints that preserve source temporal precision and never overwrite canonical time.
Surface related milestones as useful signals while keeping the original target unresolved unless CAP-0004 records a direct match.
Compose explicit historical controversy with a separately labelled current research-only MODEL/JUDGMENT overlay from CAP-0006 without collapsing authority classes.
Additional storage adapters implementing the same typed reader contracts.

active.title: Historical model-memory campaign and verification
active.purpose: Own blind memory-exhaustion, sealing, post-seal verification and the explicitly research-only state that remains around Memory Leads: disagreement cases, hypothesis assessments, model judgments and model-memory campaign coverage. These states guide research and may carry useful labelled analytical judgments such as causality, participant importance or ambiguous role, but remain below Evidence authority, never create canonical truth and are never backdated into historical market knowledge.
extension_seams: Add orthogonal recall/search families without weakening the sealed blind/search boundary or forcing uncertain memory into false precision.
Add cross-model refresh/backfill evaluation as a new instrument vintage, not overwrite.
Expose explicit current research-only disagreement/hypothesis/coverage state through typed readers while preserving its non-Evidence authority class.

Use research-only hypotheses for explicitly labelled analytical judgments such as causality, participant importance or ambiguous value-chain role when reasoning/context/confidence remain visible and the result is not promoted to canonical truth.

active.title: Fail-closed research and epistemic-trajectory orchestration
active.purpose: Own campaign-agnostic execution-stage composition from a verified local material root through Grounded Evidence and, when declared, existing Reality, contemporaneous Judgment, later Outcome and sealed point-in-time replay executors. CAP-0007 owns composition, phase ordering, acceptance gates, immutable-path checks and portable receipts; it delegates source truthfulness to CAP-0001/2, Reality to CAP-0003, Judgment/Outcome to CAP-0004 and historical visibility to CAP-0005. Research-orchestration/v2 remains transport-neutral; legacy v1 source-pack replay remains compatibility only.
extension_seams: Route researcher/task invocation adapters through the same orchestration and trajectory contracts rather than campaign-specific workflow logic.
Add a bounded execution phase only when another existing capability already owns the phase semantics; CAP-0007 composes and gates rather than reimplements.

Historical-recovery discovery stays upstream in CAP-0006; compose only source material that CAP-0001/CAP-0002 have truthfully preserved and grounded. Raw-file materialization is optional unless byte-level/source-format verification is itself claim-relevant.
Add researcher-readable output/presentation after typed CAP-0005 replay rather than changing knowledge-cutoff filtering in the orchestration layer.

active.title: Current collection scheduling and operational queue
active.purpose: Own cadence selection and due-work dispatch semantics for source-first current collection while keeping operational leases/retries separate from research history.
extension_seams: Add source watchlist/scheduler adapters without moving current-source archival semantics into historical recovery.
Add operational priority signals while preserving lease/idempotency boundaries.

active.title: Repository-backed session continuity and data-plane handoff
active.purpose: Own bounded fresh-agent recovery of mission/current horizon/live cursor plus resume-relevant binary identity, and route into cold project history only when a relevant cue appears; live Git/CI and original repository history remain authority.
extension_seams: Add compact required bootstrap references when a new permanent governance mechanism must survive every handoff.
Add resume-relevant asset transport metadata without turning the handoff into a historical asset ledger.
Improve on-demand routing into cold Git/Issue/receipt history without preloading or duplicating that history into the handoff.

active.title: Stable capability ownership and admission governance
active.purpose: Own the sparse machine-readable map of what Longcycle already knows how to do and force material development to classify as reuse/extend/replace/new before creating new semantic ownership.
extension_seams: Improve deterministic discovery/routing without making opaque similarity a hard blocker.
Tighten admission requirements as governance_mode matures from converging toward core-locked architecture.
